question: Why does ritual conception fail in the unlimited nondual reality?
premises: In unlimited non-division no conception of sacrifice and similar rites applies.
Those with unlimited aspiration and vision transcending all that do not operate through such ritual conception.
Even so, the supreme nondual reality can be known.
inference: Ritual construction is incompatible with the unlimited nondual state, though knowledge of that state remains possible.
uncertainties: The token 1.1131 appears as an editorial reference within the verse sequence.
plain_english: For in the unlimited, undivided reality there is no conception of sacrifice and the like; those whose desire is unlimited and whose vision has transcended all that stand beyond it. Even so, the beautiful supreme nondual reality can be known.
